selection_process: Selection proceeds through several sequential stages; only candidates qualifying each stage move to the next.
RFID-Based Physical Standard Test (PST) & Physical Efficiency Test (PET): Height/chest/weight measurement and the qualifying run

as detailed above. Documentation Verification (DV): Conducted alongside PST/PET reporting; candidates must produce the original of the payment receipt/challan and the printed application form/notification copy. Computer Based Test (CBT): 100-mark objective-type question paper. Minimum pass marks: 35% for General/EWS candidates; 33% for SC/ST/OBC candidates. Candidates successful in the RFID PET/PST

Documentation Verification and CBT are shortlisted to the Trade Skill Test. Trade Skill Test: Based on a Computer Based Trade Test and a Specific Practical Skill Test; no marks are awarded (purely qualifying – pass/fail). Shortlisting for the Skill Test is based on merit in the CBT

at roughly 4 times the number of vacancies (1:4 ratio) per trade/category. Detailed Medical Examination (DME) & Review Medical Examination (RME): Conducted as per the Uniform Guidelines for Recruitment Medical Examination for GOs and NGOs in CAPFs and AR (MHA UO No. A.VI-1/2014-Rectt(SSB) dated 20 May 2015
and MHA OM No. E.32012/ADG(Med)/DME&RME-DA-1/2020(Part File)/1166 dated 31 May 2021
as amended). Merit List & Call for Training: Candidates qualifying in all stages (PST
and Medical Examination) are placed in a trade- and category-wise Merit List

per the vacancies in Appendix ‘B’. Instructions to join the Training Centre are issued based on the Merit List. Qualifying all tests does not by itself guarantee final selection – final selection depends on a candidate’s position in the Merit List against category/trade vacancy availability.
Note: Pay scale and other allowances will be applicable as per the pay scale applicable to Assam Rifles personnel – the specific numeric pay matrix is not stated in this notification.

Candidates relaxing physical standards by virtue of belonging to Garhwalis, Kumaonis, Gorkhas, Dogras and Marathas categories must furnish a certificate as per format issued by the competent authority; ST candidates may avail their relaxation on production of a valid ST certificate, at the time of reporting for PST/PET. | All India except Ladakh Region: Male candidates must qualify a 5 km run within 24 minutes. Ladakh Region only: Male candidates must qualify a 1.6 km run within 7 minutes. RFID (Radio Frequency Identification Device)-based PST/PET will be conducted at Jorhat (Assam) or Diphu (Assam) centre; the exact reporting date will be intimated later on the official website after successful submission of the online application.

how_to_apply: Visit assamrifles.gov.in and click on “ONLINE APPLICATION”.
Fill in the requisite details as prescribed in the application form.
Make the online payment via the link given for online payment, or alternatively pay offline through SBI Bank Counters using the generated challan.
Upload the copy of the payment receipt/challan online.
Print the completed Online Application Form and a copy of the notification downloaded from the Assam Rifles website; keep these ready to carry to the PST/PET reporting.
Submit the application well before the closing date – the portal stops functioning from the day of publication of the advertisement to the last date of receipt of applications.

content_sections.heading: Assam Rifles Technical & Tradesman Rally 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection proceeds through several sequential stages; only candidates qualifying each stage move to the next. RFID-Based Physical Standard Test (PST) & Physical Efficiency Test (PET): Height/chest/weight measurement and the qualifying run, as detailed above. Documentation Verification (DV): Conducted alongside PST/PET reporting; candidates must produce the original of the payment receipt/challan and the printed application form/notification copy. Computer Based Test (CBT): 100-mark objective-type question paper. Minimum pass marks: 35% for General/EWS candidates; 33% for SC/ST/OBC candidates. Candidates successful in the RFID PET/PST, Documentation Verification and CBT are shortlisted to the Trade Skill Test. Trade Skill Test: Based on a Computer Based Trade Test and a Specific Practical Skill Test; no marks are awarded (purely qualifying – pass/fail). Shortlisting for the Skill Test is based on merit in the CBT, at roughly 4 times the number of vacancies (1:4 ratio) per trade/category. Detailed Medical Examination (DME) & Review Medical Examination (RME): Conducted as per the Uniform Guidelines for Recruitment Medical Examination for GOs and NGOs in CAPFs and AR (MHA UO No. A.VI-1/2014-Rectt(SSB) dated 20 May 2015, and MHA OM No. E.32012/ADG(Med)/DME&RME-DA-1/2020(Part File)/1166 dated 31 May 2021, as amended). Merit List & Call for Training: Candidates qualifying in all stages (PST, PET, CBT/Trade Skill Test, and Medical Examination) are placed in a trade- and category-wise Merit List, per the vacancies in Appendix ‘B’. Instructions to join the Training Centre are issued based on the Merit List. Qualifying all tests does not by itself guarantee final selection – final selection depends on a candidate’s position in the Merit List against category/trade vacancy availability. Note: Pay scale and other allowances will be applicable as per the pay scale applicable to Assam Rifles personnel – the specific numeric pay matrix is not stated in this notification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Assam Rifles Technical & Tradesman Rally 2026
content_sections.text: Important: Only a single application per candidate is accepted online; multiple applications will not be accepted. While reporting for RFID-based PST/PET, candidates must produce the original copy of the payment receipt/challan for official records; failure to submit it, or the printed application form/notification copy, may lead to rejection of candidature.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Matriculation/Secondary Examination Certificate (or equivalent), for proof of Date of Birth and Name Educational qualification certificate(s)/Diploma/ITI certificate for the trade applied for Domicile/Permanent Resident Certificate (PRC), issued by the competent authority Scheduled Caste (SC)/Scheduled Tribe (ST)/Other Backward Classes (OBC)/Economically Weaker Section (EWS) certificate, in the prescribed format, where applicable Ex-Servicemen discharge certificate, where claiming ESM quota/relaxation Relaxed physical standard certificate, for candidates belonging to Garhwalis, Kumaonis, Gorkhas, Dogras and Marathas categories, issued by the competent authority Valid ST certificate, for ST candidates availing relaxation in physical standards Printout of the completed Online Application Form Original copy of the payment receipt/challan Printed copy of the notification downloaded from the Assam Rifles website No Objection Certificate (NOC), for departmental (serving Assam Rifles) candidates, issued by the Commanding Officer/Officer Commanding of the Unit through the Colonel (Record), HQ DGAR

faq.question: Q1. How many posts has Assam Rifles advertised in this Rally?
faq.answer: 354 Group C posts across 18 technical trades, all-India, with no state-wise quota.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: 28 October 2026, till 23:59 hrs; the online portal opens on 28 September 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Can women apply for this Rally?
faq.answer: No. All 18 advertised trades are open to male candidates only.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Most trades require 18–23 years; Cipher, Draughtsman, Operation Theatre Technician and Physiotherapist require 18–25 years, as on the cut-off date of 1 July 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: RFID-based Physical Standard Test (PST) and Physical Efficiency Test (PET), Documentation Verification, a Computer Based Test (CBT), a Trade Skill Test, and a Detailed/Review Medical Examination, followed by a trade- and category-wise Merit List.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: Rs. 100/- for Group C posts; no fee for SC/ST and Ex-Servicemen candidates. The fee is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q7. Is there a quota for Ex-Servicemen?
faq.answer: Yes, 10% of vacancies are earmarked for Ex-Servicemen in most of the advertised trades; unfilled ESM vacancies go to non-ESM candidates of the same category.

faq.question: Q8. Where do I apply?
faq.answer: Online only, through assamrifles.gov.in; only one application per candidate is accepted.
